title: V11.20 Attribution Key Ledger Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/attribution-keys.jsonl. Append-only log of (attribution_key, layer, attributed_at) triples written by wave-review-attribute and swarm-review-attribute. Used for idempotency: before writing a new agent-errors.jsonl entry from a wave/swarm finding, the attribute script checks whether the key already exists here. Same finding twice = same key = skipped. Replay-resistant. Dedup check: before appending, scan attribution-keys.jsonl for the key string (grep or python set-load). If present, skip the write to agent-errors.jsonl AND skip the append here. JSONL format means JSON Schema CANNOT enforce uniqueness — enforcement is the write-path contract in T5/T6/T10/T11. Note: lite findings (V11.15) and runtime findings (future) do NOT enter this ledger — lite is already idempotent via task-keyed review-queue, runtime has no concept of attribution_key (no file/line at the error origin).

attribution_key.description: SHA256 hex of '|'.join(project, task_id, file, line, error_id). Identical to attribution_key on the agent-errors.jsonl line.

layer.description: Which layer wrote this entry. lite findings do not enter this ledger (V11.15 already idempotent via task-keyed queue).

task_id.description: Resolved task_id; null if finding was unattributable.

agent_id.description: Resolved executing agent_id; 'unattributed' if no task touched the finding's file.
